positions.name: SlugGenerationOnMissingId
positions.frame: when a memory arrives without an explicit id, what must the pipeline do to produce one?
positions.why: src-1 establishes the triggering condition — no explicit id field was supplied — and src-2 states the pipeline's required response to that condition: derive a slug via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback, and commit successfully. Read together, one names the gap and the other names the mandated fill; register observations mark both in the pipeline's own working jargon (slug, slugify, fallback) rather than glossed for outsiders, and conviction/power readings show a flat factual claim (src-1) paired with an operational, authority-ranked 'must' rule (src-2) — a tension between reported state and imposed requirement that the frame holds without resolving.
